what_this_adds.third_distinct_design: key-level raw viability (R86) saturated; key-level residual (R105) had identity anti-predicting; pair-level residual (this round) has BOTH models anti-correlating
what_this_adds.arena_has_no_positive_signal: identity's Spearman rho on the pair-level target is -0.165, so the gate that the arena must first carry positive signal fails
what_this_adds.consequence: C78 is confirmed across three arenas and three units of analysis, and the confirmation is now robust to the choice of unit rather than resting on one design
what_this_adds.caveat_that_stays: the negative rho is the same signature that appeared in R105, and it may again be a modelling artefact rather than a property of the data. Either way it blocks the cross-dataset test, so the promotion verdict is unchanged.
